n: 30 in. Black Stainless Steel Over the Range Convection Microwave Oven with Traditional Handle
hl: Luxury isn't meant to be desired - it's meant to be attainable. Inspired by Lake Tahoe, USA, the ZLINE Over the Range Convection Microwave Oven in Stainless Steel with Traditional Handle and Sensor Cooking provides a professional culinary experience by pairing unmatched performance with timeless style. Achieve ZLINE Attainable Luxury excellence with innovative features designed to enhance your kitchen's capability.
2-Speed Powerful Ventilation - Enjoy up to a 300 CFM air flow that effectively removes unwanted smoke and grease from your kitchen - configurable for either recirculating or external ducting
Convection and Microwave Modes - Select from a variety of convection and microwave cooking settings to provide optimal dish results
One-Touch Cooking - Easy One-Touch controls allow you to quickly heat your favorite snacks and dishes
DiamondTech Interior - A unique stainless steel interior is engineered to scatter microwaves to ensure even cooking and prevent any cold spots
Cooktop Lighting - Easily illuminate your cooking space with 2 built-in lights
